children: Virtuals Protocol's Astra agent controls a full humanoid robot for the first time, extending zero-shot robot-use to humanoid platforms for open-ended pick-and-place tasks. The demonstration moves the agent beyond simulated or fixed hardware setups and shows it operating a physical robot body directly.

The result validates Virtuals ecosystem agents as operators of physical-world hardware, not only software services. For VIRTUAL, this is a narrative catalyst: agents gain expanded speculative utility in robotics, a use case that investors may reprice into the token's perceived value. The demo carries no stated token-economic change, so any repricing rests on expectations for future agent deployment rather than on new token mechanics.
